description.en: Keeps only lines N to M of each selection (enter `N-M`, 1 ≤ N ≤ M ≤ 1,000,000; like `sed -n 'N,Mp'`). Lines beyond the selection are ignored, so a range after the last line leaves nothing. **Line: Keep First N Lines** / **Line: Keep Last N Lines** always start at the first / last line.
description.ja: 各選択の N 行目から M 行目だけを残す（`N-M` を入力。1 ≤ N ≤ M ≤ 1,000,000。`sed -n 'N,Mp'` 相当）。選択の行数を超える部分は無視し、範囲がすべて最終行より後なら空になる（先頭・末尾固定は **Line: Keep First N Lines** / **Line: Keep Last N Lines**）

description.en: Removes the first N lines (N is an integer from 1 to 1,000,000, default 1; N at or above the line count leaves nothing). **Line: Keep Last N Lines** keeps N lines instead.
description.ja: 先頭 N 行を削除する（N は 1〜1,000,000 の整数、既定値 1。N が行数以上なら空になる。末尾 N 行を残すのは **Line: Keep Last N Lines**）

description.en: Removes the last N lines (N is entered as in **Line: Remove First N Lines**).
description.ja: 末尾 N 行を削除する（N は **Line: Remove First N Lines** と同じ）

description.en: Inserts an empty line after every N lines (N is an integer from 1 to 1,000,000, default 2), but not after the last line. The added length is checked before the result is built. Unlike **Whitespace: Insert Blank Line Between Lines**, which adds one only between two adjacent non-blank lines, it does not look at whether a line is blank (`a⏎⏎b` with N=1 gives `a⏎⏎⏎⏎b`).
description.ja: N 行ごとに空行を挿入する（N は 1〜1,000,000 の整数、既定値 2。末尾には入れない）。増える文字数は結果を作る前に確認する。隣り合う 2 つの非空行の間にだけ入れる **Whitespace: Insert Blank Line Between Lines** と違い、空行かどうかは見ない（`a⏎⏎b` に N=1 なら `a⏎⏎⏎⏎b`）

description.en: Keeps only the Mth to Nth characters of each line (enter `M-N` or a single position `N`, 1 to 1,000,000; like `cut -c`). Characters are grapheme clusters, so an emoji sequence counts as one. A shorter line keeps what it has (possibly nothing).
description.ja: 各行の M〜N 文字目だけを残す（`M-N` または 1 か所の `N` を入力、1〜1,000,000。`cut -c` 相当）。文字は書記素クラスタ単位で数える（絵文字の連結も 1 文字）。短い行は残る部分だけ（空もありうる）になる

description.en: Joins line i of every non-empty selection (two or more, in document order) with a delimiter you enter (up to 100 characters; empty uses a tab), like `paste`. The result replaces the first selection; the other selections are not changed. A selection with fewer lines contributes empty strings.
description.ja: 2 つ以上の非空の選択（文書順）の i 行目どうしを入力した区切り文字（100 文字まで。空欄ならタブ）で連結する（`paste` 相当）。結果は 1 つ目の選択を置き換え、他の選択は変えない。行数が足りない選択は空文字として連結する

description.en: Removes duplicate lines, keeping the last occurrence of each line (the relative order of the kept lines does not change). The other duplicate removals keep the first occurrence.
description.ja: 重複行のうち最後の出現を残して削除する（残った行の相対順は変えない。ほかの重複削除コマンドは最初の出現を残す）

description.en: Replaces every match of the regular expression you enter (JavaScript syntax, `u` flag, case-sensitive) with a line break. To guard against ReDoS, the pattern must be 1 to 500 characters, the target is limited to 10,000,000 characters in total, matching runs in a Worker thread and is aborted after 2 seconds, and more than 1,000,000 matches stop the command. If the document is edited during matching, nothing is changed. **Text - Split Lines (Custom Delimiter)** splits at a literal string.
description.ja: 入力した正規表現（JavaScript 構文・`u` フラグ・大文字小文字を区別）に一致した部分を改行に置き換える。ReDoS 対策として、パターンは 1〜500 文字、対象は合計 10,000,000 文字まで、照合は Worker スレッドで行って 2 秒で打ち切り、一致が 1,000,000 件を超えたら中止する。照合中に文書が編集された場合は変更しない（文字列で区切るのは **Text - Split Lines (Custom Delimiter)**）

description.en: Joins the lines into one natural-language list with `Intl.ListFormat` (conjunction) for the locale you enter (default `en`; an empty or unsupported locale is rejected). Blank lines (empty, or only spaces, tabs or full-width spaces) are left out.
description.ja: 行を `Intl.ListFormat`（conjunction）で、入力したロケール（既定値 `en`。空欄・未対応のロケールは拒否）の自然言語の列挙に連結する。空白だけの行（空行・半角／全角空白・タブだけの行）は除く

description.en: Writes the lines that are in both of exactly two non-empty selections (exact match, each once, in the order of the first) into the first selection; the second selection is not changed.
description.ja: ちょうど 2 つの非空の選択の両方にある行（完全一致、重複なし、1 つ目の順）を 1 つ目の選択に書き込む（2 つ目は変えない）

description.en: Writes the lines of the first of two non-empty selections that are not in the second (exact match, each once) into the first selection; the second selection is not changed.
description.ja: 2 つの非空の選択のうち、1 つ目にあり 2 つ目にない行（完全一致、重複なし）を 1 つ目の選択に書き込む（2 つ目は変えない）

description.en: Writes the lines that are in only one of two non-empty selections (the first selection's lines, then the second's, each once) into the first selection; the second selection is not changed.
description.ja: 2 つの非空の選択のどちらか一方にしかない行（1 つ目だけの行の後に 2 つ目だけの行、重複なし）を 1 つ目の選択に書き込む（2 つ目は変えない）

description.en: Numbers only the non-blank lines as `number space line` (`1 a`, no colon or padding; **Line: Add Line Numbers** writes `1: a`). Blank lines are not numbered, keep their content and do not use up a number. Unlike `nl -b t`, a line of only spaces, tabs or full-width spaces is treated as blank and gets no number.
description.ja: 空行を飛ばして非空行だけに「番号 + 半角空白」で行番号を付ける（`1 a` 形式、コロン・ゼロ埋めなし。**Line: Add Line Numbers** は `1: a`）。空行は番号を付けず内容もそのままで、番号を消費しない。`nl -b t` と異なり、半角／全角空白・タブだけの行も空行として扱い番号を付けない

description.en: Arranges the lines down N columns (N is 1 to 100, default 2; rows = ceil(lines / N), filled column by column, like `column -c`), each column as wide as its widest line plus two spaces, without trailing spaces. Widths are counted in code points (a full-width character counts as 1). A result over the output limit changes nothing.
description.ja: 行を縦方向に N 列（1〜100、既定値 2）へ並べ（行数 = ceil(行数 / N)、列ごとに上から埋める。`column -c` 相当）、各列を最も長い行の幅 + 空白 2 つに揃える（行末の空白は除く）。幅はコードポイント数で数える（全角文字も 1）。出力上限を超える場合は変更しない

description.en: Selects every email address (the pattern of **Extract Email**, found in linear time) inside the non-empty selections; when every selection is empty (cursors), the whole document is searched. A match must lie inside one selection. At most 100,000 selections are made.
description.ja: 非空の選択の内側にあるメールアドレス（**Extract Email** と同じパターンを線形時間で検索）をすべて選択する。すべての選択が空（カーソルだけ）のときは文書全体を対象にする。一致は 1 つの選択の内側に収まるものだけ。選択数は 100,000 まで

description.en: Selects every IPv4 address (each number 0–255) and IPv6 address (validated without the `net` module; `::` and an embedded IPv4 address are allowed) inside the non-empty selections, or in the whole document when every selection is empty. Trailing dots are not selected, and an IPv4 address inside an IPv6 address is not selected separately.
description.ja: 非空の選択の内側（すべて空なら文書全体）の IPv4（各数値 0〜255）・IPv6（`net` モジュールを使わずに検証。`::` 省略と IPv4 埋め込み形式を含む）アドレスをすべて選択する。末尾の `.` は含めず、IPv6 内の IPv4 は別に選ばない

description.en: Selects every `#rgb`, `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` color not followed by a letter or digit, inside the non-empty selections or, when every selection is empty, in the whole document.
description.ja: 非空の選択の内側（すべて空なら文書全体）の `#rgb`／`#rrggbb`／`#rrggbbaa` 形式の色（直後が英数字でないもの）をすべて選択する

description.en: Selects every UUID (8-4-4-4-12 hex digits not touching a letter or digit) inside the non-empty selections or, when every selection is empty, in the whole document.
description.ja: 非空の選択の内側（すべて空なら文書全体）の UUID（8-4-4-4-12 桁の 16 進数で、前後が英数字でないもの）をすべて選択する

description.en: Selects every ISO date `YYYY-MM-DD` (optionally with `T` or a space and `HH:MM[:SS[.fff]]` and a time zone) inside the non-empty selections or, when every selection is empty, in the whole document. Months and days are checked, leap years included.
description.ja: 非空の選択の内側（すべて空なら文書全体）の ISO 日付 `YYYY-MM-DD`（`T` または空白に続く `HH:MM[:SS[.fff]]` とタイムゾーンを任意で含む）をすべて選択する。月日はうるう年を含めて検証する

description.en: Expands each cursor to the sentence it is in, and the start / end of each selection to the start / end of its sentence (sentences end at `.`, `!` or `?` followed by a space or a line break, or at `。`, `！`, `？`). Blank lines (empty, or only spaces, tabs or full-width spaces) end a paragraph and stop the search. Surrounding spaces are not selected; overlapping results are merged. Abbreviations such as `Mr.` are not recognized.
description.ja: 各カーソルをそれを含む文全体に、各選択の始点・終点をそれぞれの文の先頭・末尾に広げる（文は `.!?` の後に空白・改行が来る位置と `。！？` で区切る）。空白だけの行（空行・半角／全角空白・タブだけの行）は段落の区切りで、そこで探索を止める。前後の空白は含めず、重なった範囲はまとめる（`Mr.` などの略語は扱えない）

example.en: `Hi. This is| a pen. Bye.` → `Hi. [This is a pen.] Bye.`
example.ja: `Hi. This is| a pen. Bye.` → `Hi. [This is a pen.] Bye.`

description.en: Expands each cursor to its paragraph (from the start of its first line to the end of its last line; blank lines, i.e. empty or only spaces, tabs or full-width spaces, separate paragraphs), and the start / end of each selection to the start / end of its paragraph. A cursor on a blank line does not move; overlapping results are merged.
description.ja: 各カーソルを段落全体（最初の行の行頭から最後の行の行末まで。空白だけの行＝空行・半角／全角空白・タブだけの行で区切る）に、各選択の始点・終点をそれぞれの段落の先頭・末尾に広げる。空白だけの行の上のカーソルは動かさず、重なった範囲はまとめる

description.en: Keeps only the selections whose text (case-sensitive) appears in two or more selections (the reverse of **Selection - Deselect Duplicate Texts**). When there is none, only a notification is shown.
description.ja: 同じテキスト（大文字小文字を区別）の選択が 2 つ以上あるものだけを残す（**Selection - Deselect Duplicate Texts** の逆）。該当がなければ通知だけする

description.en: Joins the texts of all selections (document order) with a delimiter you enter (default `, `; up to 100 characters, and it may be empty) into the first selection and deletes the texts of the other selections, in one edit. The joined text is the only selection afterwards.
description.ja: 全選択のテキスト（文書順）を入力した区切り文字（既定値 `, `。100 文字まで、空でもよい）で連結して最初の選択に入れ、他の選択のテキストは削除する（1 回の編集）。実行後の選択は連結したテキストの 1 つだけになる
